opening: Effect of gut microbiota on immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) based cancer immunotherapy A.Y.P. Perera, S.D.S.S. Sooriyapathirana, S. Rajapakse and J.A.M.S. Jayatilake* REVIEW ARTICLE Highlights • ICI based immunotherapy is a novel approach in cancer immunotherapy. • ICI therapy mainly targets the immune checkpoints, namely PD-1 and CTLA-4. • Gut microbiota affects the ICI therapy by modulating both PD-1 and CTLA-4. • Different gut bacteria have shown varying responses with ICI therapy. • Individual variation of gut microbiota challenges its application in ICI therapy. *Corresponding Author’s Email: sumedhaj@pdn.ac.lk Effect of gut microbiota on immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) based cancer immunotherapy A.Y.P.
